categories.cause: POSIX-only process control: os.setsid/getpgid/killpg, signal.SIGKILL, RLIMIT, and `sh -c`. Includes a genuine runtime gap: task_budget._terminate_group catches only (ProcessLookupError, PermissionError, OSError), while Windows raises AttributeError from os.killpg, which escapes uncaught — wall-clock deadline process-group termination is unavailable on this platform.
fixtures need symlinks or FIFOs; Windows needs Developer Mode/elevation for symlinks (WinError 1314) and has no mkfifo

byte-identity / frozen-digest assertions. Generators embed platform font paths (the failure message names '/Library/Fonts/STHeiti Medium.ttc' and '/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc'), and regenerated DOCX/PDF are not byte-reproducible across platforms. Prompt-hash baselines likewise differ.

catalog snapshot identity: this machine's database yields snap-demo_retail-9b6637f76e61 / snap-industrial-4fd6776592a800b8b082 while the expectations carry the author's snap-demo_retail-e9495c660cd1. db/seed_demo_retail.py, db/build_catalog.py and db/seed_eval_cases.py were NOT changed in the 68 commits, so this is an environment/data-identity difference that predates the merge.
the test shells out to `shasum`; Git for Windows ships it only as D:/zzu/Git/usr/bin/core_perl/shasum (a Perl script with no executable PATH entry)
the test asserts the stored object_uri contains '/data/'; on Windows it is a backslash path
